# cppjieba

Vendored from <https://github.com/yanyiwu/cppjieba> at commit
`8fe7b9304d2730320e2e275721b1b330056c581b`.

Only the header-only cppjieba and limonp runtime dependencies are retained.
Upstream tests, examples, dictionaries, build files, and repository metadata are
intentionally excluded. See `LICENSE.cppjieba` and `LICENSE.limonp`.
